narrative.gap_prioritization_md: Priority Score = (0.25 × Business Impact) + (0.20 × Peer Comparison) + (0.15 × Strategic Alignment) + (0.15 × Implementation Complexity Inverse) + (0.15 × Investment Efficiency) + (0.10 × Stakeholder Readiness). Six of the top 8 gaps map directly to Zennify Salesforce solutions. Two gaps ( Culture, ESG) are CLIENT-responsibility items requiring internal programs, not technology investment.
narrative.recommendations_md: All six recommendations follow the MANDATORY ANTI-GENERIC RECOMMENDATION PROTOCOL: (1) Specific E-IDs confirm the gap exists; (2) Proxy searches exhausted for net-new validation; (3) Maps to a named Zennify solution from the 12-solution catalog; (4) Each includes peer deployment validation showing comparable institutions have deployed the solution. No investment amounts, cost estimates, or ROI projections appear anywhere in this section.
narrative.roadmap_md: The 18-month transformation roadmap phases Zennify's six recommendations to maximize connected unlocks and sequence dependencies correctly. Phase 1 (Foundation) pre-empts bespoke vendor lock-in at the two highest-urgency items (Data Cloud, FSC). Phase 2 (Automation) governs the active AI and API investments before technical debt deepens. Phase 3 (Scale) migrates the Power BI COE and unifies case management. Each phase removes connected caps that unlock subsequent maturity gains.
